name: rosetta-logical-operations
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

report(left: bool, right: bool) is
    write_line("{left} and {right}: {left /\ right}")
    write_line("{left} or {right}: {left \/ right}")
    write_line("not {left}: {!left}")
    write_line("{left} xor {right}: {left != right}")
si

report(true, false)
report(true, true)
fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line

report(left: bool, right: bool) is
    write_line("{left} and {right}: {left /\ right}")
    write_line("{left} or {right}: {left \/ right}")
    write_line("not {left}: {!left}")
    write_line("{left} xor {right}: {left != right}")
si

report(true, false)
report(true, true)
output:
True and False: False
True or False: True
not True: False
True xor False: True
True and True: True
True or True: True
not True: False
True xor True: False
